title: Echocardiography and Heart Failure — Ejection Fraction and Safe Exercise

hook.en: An echo report gives an "ejection fraction" that patients and families often misunderstand. Learn what it shows, the report terms and how to plan safe exercise for people with heart failure.
hook.ur: Echo report "ejection fraction" deti hai jise mareez aur ghar walay aksar ghalat samajhte hain. Seekhein yeh kya dikhati hai, report ke alfaz aur dil ki nakami wale logon ke liye mehfooz exercise ka plan.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain what an echocardiogram shows, state the normal ejection fraction and the heart failure categories, understand common report terms (valve disease, wall motion, pulmonary pressure) and plan and monitor exercise safely in heart failure.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke echocardiogram kya dikhata hai, normal ejection fraction aur heart failure ki categories batayenge, report ke aam alfaz (valve disease, wall motion, pulmonary pressure) samjhenge aur heart failure mein exercise ka mehfooz plan aur nigrani karenge.

text.en: An **echocardiogram** is an ultrasound of the heart. It shows the **size of the chambers, how well the heart muscle squeezes, how the valves open and close** and whether there is fluid around the heart. The key number is the **left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF)**: the percentage of blood the left ventricle pumps out with each beat. **Normal is roughly 55 to 70 percent.** In heart failure, **50 percent or more** is called preserved (HFpEF), **41 to 49** mildly reduced, and **40 or below** reduced (HFrEF).
text.ur: **Echocardiogram** dil ka ultrasound hai. Yeh **khanon ka size, dil ka muscle kitni achhi tarah sikurta hai, valves kaise khulte aur band hote hain** aur dil ke gird paani hai ya nahi dikhata hai. Aham number **left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF)** hai: har dharkan mein left ventricle jitne fi sad khoon bahar dhakelta hai. **Normal takreeban 55 se 70 percent.** Heart failure mein **50 percent ya zyada** preserved (HFpEF), **41 se 49** halki kam, aur **40 ya kam** reduced (HFrEF) kehlata hai.

text.en: Think of the heart as **a water pump**. Ejection fraction is how much of the water in the pump chamber is pushed out on each stroke. A healthy pump empties about two-thirds. A weak pump empties less, so the body gets less flow. Some pumps are stiff and do not fill well (preserved ejection fraction), which also causes trouble. The number alone does not say how the person feels.
text.ur: Dil ko **paani ka pump** samjhein. Ejection fraction yeh hai ke pump ke khane ka kitna paani har dharkan mein bahar jata hai. Sehatmand pump takreeban do tihai khali karta hai. Kamzor pump kam khali karta hai, is liye jism ko kam bahaao milta hai. Kuch pump sakht hote hain aur theek se bharte nahi (preserved ejection fraction), jo masle paida karta hai. Akela number nahi batata ke shakhs kaisa mehsoos karta hai.

title.en: Reading an echo report for exercise planning
title.ur: Exercise ke liye echo report parhna

steps.title: Find the ejection fraction
steps.detail: Read the LVEF and the method; a very low value (below 30 to 35 percent) or a recent drop needs closer care. Remember that it can change with treatment. || Ejection fraction dhoondein

steps.title: Check the valves and the walls
steps.detail: Look for severe valve narrowing or leaking (severe aortic stenosis is a reason to avoid vigorous exercise), "wall motion abnormality" (an area that moves poorly, often after a heart attack) and the size of the chambers. || Valves aur deewarein dekhein

steps.title: Note the pressures and fluid
steps.detail: "Raised pulmonary artery pressure" suggests the lungs are under strain; a "pericardial effusion" is fluid around the heart. Both need the medical team's guidance before exercise. || Pressure aur paani note karein

steps.title: Plan, monitor and review
steps.detail: Use the NYHA class (how breathless the person is in daily life), the effort scale and symptoms. Begin at low to moderate effort, monitor blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen and signs of fluid build-up (weight, swelling), and review often. || Plan, nigrani aur review

question.en: What is a normal left ventricular ejection fraction?
question.ur: Normal left ventricular ejection fraction kitna hai?

feedback.en: Yes — below 50 percent is called reduced or mildly reduced.
feedback.ur: Haan — 50 percent se kam reduced ya halka reduced kehlata hai.
Dil kabhi poori tarah khali nahi hota.

rows.en: The muscle is stiff and fills poorly
rows.ur: Muscle sakht aur theek se nahi bharta

rows.en: High blood pressure, age, obesity, diabetes
rows.ur: High blood pressure, umar, motapa, diabetes

rows.en: Safe and helpful when stable; start low and monitor
rows.ur: Mustaqil ho to mehfooz aur mufeed; kam se shuru aur nigrani

rows.en: Safe and helpful; training improves symptoms
rows.ur: Mehfooz aur mufeed; training alamaat behtar karti hai

text.en: **The number is a start, not the story.** Two people with the same ejection fraction can feel very different. Plan exercise from symptoms, effort, stability and the doctor's advice, and monitor weight and swelling.
text.ur: **Number shuruaat hai, kahani nahi.** Ek jaisi ejection fraction wale do log bohat mukhtalif mehsoos kar sakte hain. Exercise ka plan alamaat, effort, istehkam aur doctor ke mashware se banayein, aur wazan aur sujan ki nigrani karein.

text.en: **Telling patients with heart failure to rest.** Rest weakens the muscles and worsens breathlessness. Stable patients benefit from supervised exercise training. The rule is to be gradual and to hold exercise in an unstable phase (new swelling, rapid weight gain, worsening breathlessness).
text.ur: **Heart failure ke mareezon ko aaram ka kehna.** Aaram muscles kamzor karta hai aur saans ki tangi barhata hai. Mustaqil mareezon ko nigrani wali exercise training se faida hota hai. Usool yeh hai ke aahista chalein aur ghair mustaqil marhale mein (nayi sujan, tezi se wazan barhna, barhti saans ki tangi) exercise rokein.

question.en: Which finding makes you hold exercise in a patient with heart failure and contact the doctor?
question.ur: Heart failure ke mareez mein kaun si finding exercise rokne aur doctor se rabta karne ka kehti hai?

text.en: A mild muscle ache after exercise
text.ur: Exercise ke baad halka muscle dard

text.en: Weight up by 2 kg in 3 days with new ankle swelling and worse breathlessness
text.ur: 3 din mein 2 kg wazan barhna, takhnon par nayi sujan aur saans ki tangi barhna

feedback.en: Yes — this suggests fluid build-up and an unstable phase.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh paani jama hone aur ghair mustaqil marhale ki nishani hai.

question.en: An echo shows severe aortic stenosis. What should you do about exercise?
question.ur: Echo mein shadeed aortic stenosis hai. Exercise ke baare mein kya karein?

text.ur: Valve ki finding nazar andaz karein

feedback.ur: Yeh exercise ka plan badalti hai.

text.ur: Foran zyada shiddat ki training shuru karein

text.en: Avoid vigorous exercise and ask the cardiologist what is safe
text.ur: Sakht exercise se bachein aur cardiologist se poochhein kya mehfooz hai

feedback.en: Yes — severe valve narrowing limits the heart's ability to raise output.
feedback.ur: Haan — valve ki shadeed tangi dil ki output barhane ki salahiyat mehdood karti hai.

text.en: **Teach self-monitoring.** Ask patients with heart failure to weigh themselves each morning, check their ankles and know their warning signs. Give a clear plan: when to call the clinic and when to call an ambulance. Explain that exercise is part of treatment and that their medicines help them to exercise.
text.ur: **Khud nigrani sikhayein.** Heart failure ke mareezon se kahein ke har subah wazan karein, takhne dekhein aur apni warning signs jaanein. Saaf plan dein: kab clinic ko call karna hai aur kab ambulance. Samjhayein ke exercise ilaj ka hissa hai aur dawaiyan unhein exercise karne mein madad deti hain.

question.en: Why does exercise training help people with a weak heart?
question.ur: Kamzor dil wale logon ko exercise training se faida kyun hota hai?

answer.en: Training does not strengthen the damaged heart muscle much, but it improves the muscles, the blood vessels and the way the body uses oxygen. As a result, the same effort feels easier, breathlessness falls and quality of life improves.
answer.ur: Training zakhmi dil ke muscle ko zyada mazboot nahi karti, magar muscles, khoon ki naliyon aur jism ke oxygen istemal karne ke tareeqe ko behtar karti hai. Is ke nateeje mein wohi mehnat aasan lagti hai, saans ki tangi kam hoti hai aur zindagi ka maiyar behtar hota hai.

beats.patient: A 60-year-old man with an ejection fraction of 35 percent after a heart attack joins an exercise programme. He is on stable medicines, breathless on stairs (NYHA class 2) and has no swelling. His blood pressure and oxygen are normal.
beats.assessment: He is stable with reduced ejection fraction; supervised, gradual exercise is appropriate and helpful.
beats.treatment: Start walking and cycling at an effort of 11 to 13, add leg strength, monitor blood pressure, heart rate, symptoms and weight, and teach warning signs.
beats.reassess: After 12 weeks he walks 30 minutes comfortably, with less breathlessness on stairs.

text.en: **Stop exercise and call for help** for chest pain, severe breathlessness, faintness, a fall in blood pressure, a new fast or irregular rhythm with symptoms or sudden swelling. Do not exercise a patient who is unstable, has a fever, has new or worsening fluid build-up, or has severe uncontrolled valve disease without clearance. Never advise stopping heart failure medicines.
text.ur: **Exercise rokein aur madad bulayein** seene ka dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, behoshi jaisi kaifiyat, blood pressure ka girna, alamaat ke saath nayi tez ya irregular rhythm ya achanak sujan par. Ghair mustaqil, bukhar wale, nayi ya barhti paani ki jama'at wale, ya shadeed be-qaboo valve ki bimari wale mareez ko ijazat ke baghair exercise na karwayein. Heart failure ki dawaiyan band karne ka mashwara kabhi na dein.

summary.en: An echocardiogram is an ultrasound of the heart; the ejection fraction is the share of blood pumped each beat (normal about 55 to 70 percent).
summary.ur: Echocardiogram dil ka ultrasound hai; ejection fraction har dharkan mein bahar jane wale khoon ka hissa hai (normal takreeban 55 se 70 percent).

summary.en: Heart failure is grouped by ejection fraction (reduced 40 or below, mildly reduced 41 to 49, preserved 50 or more); check valves, wall motion and pressures before exercise.
summary.ur: Heart failure ejection fraction se tarteeb di jati hai (reduced 40 ya kam, halka reduced 41 se 49, preserved 50 ya zyada); exercise se pehle valves, wall motion aur pressures dekhein.

summary.en: Stable patients benefit from gradual, monitored exercise; hold it and call the doctor for fluid build-up, worsening breathlessness or other warning signs.
summary.ur: Mustaqil mareezon ko aahista, monitored exercise se faida hota hai; paani jama hone, barhti saans ki tangi ya doosri warning signs par isay rokein aur doctor ko bulayein.

front.en: What is a normal ejection fraction?

back.en: Heart failure with a reduced ejection fraction (40 percent or below).
back.ur: Heart failure jis mein ejection fraction kam hai (40 percent ya kam).

front.en: Name a sign of fluid build-up in heart failure.
front.ur: Heart failure mein paani jama hone ki ek nishani batayein.

back.en: Rapid weight gain, ankle swelling or worse breathlessness.
back.ur: Tezi se wazan barhna, takhnon ki sujan ya barhti saans ki tangi.

note.en: Exercising safely after a heart event.
note.ur: Dil ke waqiye ke baad mehfooz exercise.
Rhythm aur rukne ki nishaniyon ki nigrani.
